My name is not important, but I am a mama here in Kagera with many years on this land. This small plot of 0.28 hectares I use for other crops mixed together — I put some vegetables and roots alongside, because my family needs variety, not just bananas and beans from the bigger plots. I cannot afford to buy urea or DAP for such a small mixed plot; instead I carry manure from our cows and goats to feed the soil, which is what my mother taught me and what works here on our red soils. I keep seeds from last season as I always do, and I weed by hand with my daughter-in-law — only at planting and harvest do I sometimes pay a neighbor a small amount to help.
